citation: van Leeuwen WMA, Hublin C, Sallinen M, et al. Prolonged Sleep Restriction Affects Glucose Metabolism in Healthy Young Men. International Journal of Endocrinology. 2010.
protocol: Five nights of 4 h in bed (sleep restriction) vs 8 h control, after 2 baseline nights; fasting blood 07:30 after baseline, restriction, and 2 recovery nights
population: n=23 healthy young men (CON vs EXP)
note: Fasting morning values only (three states), no meals protocol. Gives sleep-debt effect sizes on fasting glucose/insulin/leptin.
